verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Wallets docs describe user-owned, non-custodial smart wallets where the user funds and grants scoped, revocable, onchain-enforced permissions (spend cap, counterparties, time window) to an agent signer, matching the story's provision/fund/control model. Balance visibility is supported via wallet webhooks (transfers) and the general wallet/API infrastructure for querying wallet state. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc snippet showing a 'get balance' API call or dashboard UI screenshot, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
